en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,
, and in Surah Al-Anfal (Chapter 8) is an amputation of the nose (breaking the pride of the enemies of the Ahl Al-Bayt<sup>asws</sup>)’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people has narrated Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ali ibn abu Hamza from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following.
In this chapter, al-Anfal, stands the amputation of the nose
(of enemies and proof of their humiliation).”
